note: The ONLY source of exclusion authority for the Oral review pool. A card is removed from the pool if and only if it has an entry here with accept_scope WHOLE_CARD that later evidence has not reopened. A card with no entry STAYS IN THE POOL. This file is hand-maintained and is never written by a generator.

rules.CORRECTED_IS_NOT_REVIEWED: Correction manifests rank a card; they never clear it. A card may carry many corrections and still have never been read end to end.
rules.NARROW_IS_NOT_WHOLE: NARROW_SCOPE and NO_PROPAGATION record what was actually checked. They rank only. They must never grow into a whole-card clearance.
rules.PROSE_HAS_NO_AUTHORITY: GPT_REVIEW_*.md accept-sections and (NO CHANGE) headings are reviewer hints. Tranche 1's 'Accepted cards - untouched' means no propagation reached those cards within that tranche's scope - not that they were reviewed. Promoting a hint requires adding an entry here by hand, with evidence.
rules.EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Every entry must cite the artefact that justifies it. An acceptance without a citation cannot be audited and is rejected.
rules.ACCEPTANCE_COVERS_BYTES: An acceptance covers the BYTES the reviewer read, not the card's name. canonical_card_digest is mandatory and load-bearing: if the live card's canonical digest differs from it, the acceptance no longer covers what is on the page and the card is REOPENED. Schema/1 could not express this, so /1 files are refused rather than coerced.
rules.REOPENED_IS_NOT_A_DEFECT_CLAIM: A moved digest means the prior whole-card acceptance no longer covers the current bytes. It does NOT mean the card is wrong. The card returns to the queue at its evidence-derived rank; nothing is marked P1, incorrect or failed on the strength of a digest change alone.
rules.HEAD_IS_PROVENANCE_NOT_VALIDITY: repo_head_reviewed records the tree that was read so an auditor can find it. It is NOT the validity test: unrelated commits move HEAD constantly, and treating that as invalidation would reopen every acceptance daily for a reason no reviewer could act on. The digest decides.
rules.NO_PARTIAL_RECORDS: Every field below is required on every entry, and an unrecognised field is a refusal. A half-filled accept, or one carrying a governance-looking key nothing reads, is how a reader comes to believe a check exists that does not.

accept_scope_values.WHOLE_CARD: Read end to end and accepted. EXCLUDES the card from the pool.
accept_scope_values.NARROW_SCOPE: One limb or proposition checked. Ranks only; does not exclude.
accept_scope_values.NO_PROPAGATION: A tranche's edits did not reach it. Ranks only; does not exclude.

entry_shape.evidence: required - the artefact and section that justifies this acceptance
entry_shape.date: required ISO-8601 - evidence dated after this reopens the acceptance
entry_shape.review_id: required - the review this acceptance was taken in
entry_shape.repo_head_reviewed: required - git object name of the tree that was read; provenance only
entry_shape.canonical_card_digest: required - sha256 (64 lowercase hex) over the card's balanced <div> block, LF-normalised; the SAME digest the oral correction records pin
entry_shape.residual_findings: required list, may be [] - each item {severity, note} (+ optional id, reference). Shape is validated; severity is NOT adjudicated here
entry_shape.reopen_policy: required - the human-readable policy, stored for audit. Enforcement lives in deterministic code, never in parsing this string

reopen_triggers.CARD_DIGEST_CHANGED_AFTER_ACCEPT: the live card's canonical digest differs from canonical_card_digest
reopen_triggers.ACCEPTED_CARD_ABSENT: the accepted card is no longer present in the corpus
reopen_triggers.LATER_EVIDENCE_AFTER_ACCEPT: a manifest dated after `date` names this card - this is the channel by which later regulatory/currentness evidence, contradicting source-custody evidence, a propagation defect targeting the card, and an explicit Founder/GPT reopen record all arrive
